Container.Name: tournament-genie
Container.Overview:
Tournament Genie: a Discord bot and website for a store's day of Play! Pokémon events. It creates staff-only channels for the day, records penalties with /penalty and exports the head judge's penalty CSV.
The website is reached only through Caddy, as an HTTPS reverse proxy in its own container. Genie's port 3001 is published only on this server's loopback (127.0.0.1:3001), never to the LAN. Put Genie and Caddy on a dedicated Docker network that only they share, point Caddy at tournament-genie:3001, and set NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the https:// address Caddy serves.
First run: the container log prints a one-time setup code. Before Caddy is set up, open /setup through an SSH tunnel to this server (ssh -L 3001:127.0.0.1:3001 root@your-server, then http://localhost:3001/setup). Discord credentials are entered in the browser, never here.
Container.Requires: Caddy as the HTTPS reverse proxy for the website (see the overview).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Everything Genie keeps: app.db, secrets/ and exports/. Back up the whole folder; it holds the vault key, so keep the backup private.

Config.Name: Site URL
Config.Description: Optional. The https:// address Caddy serves Genie on, like https://genie.example.com. Without it, /setup and login work only on http://localhost through an SSH tunnel.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid's nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid's users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for files Genie writes.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Optional. The store's timezone, like America/Chicago. Blank uses the container default.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Addresses or CIDR ranges whose X-Forwarded-* headers are believed (Caddy). Blank means loopback and Docker's bridge networks.

Config.Name: Session password override
Config.Description: Leave empty: generated on first boot into /data/secrets/session-password. Set only to override it.

Config.Name: Vault key override
Config.Description: Leave empty: generated on first boot into /data/secrets/vault.key. Changing it makes the stored Discord credentials unreadable.

Config.Name: Litestream replica URL
Config.Description: Optional off-box backup of the database (never secrets/), like s3://bucket/genie. Blank turns Litestream off. Back up the appdata folder either way.

Config.Name: Litestream access key ID
Config.Description: Optional. The replica's access key ID.

Config.Name: Litestream secret access key
Config.Description: Optional. The replica's secret access key.
